Le parcours est rééchantillonné tous les: The route is resampled every 5 m. Only elevations are smoothed, using a Gaussian with σ = 20 m. A reversal of 2 m confirms an ascent or descent; successive small rises still accumulate.
. Le premier modèle couvrant toute la tr: . The first model covering the entire track provides the profile. This order comes from the comparison in mainland France.
Les coordonnées GPX sont conservées. Prè: GPX coordinates are preserved. Near a cliff, their accuracy can strongly affect the result. The displayed elevation gain is an estimate using this protocol.
Les coordonnées sont envoyées au service: Coordinates are sent to IGN to read elevations. Other models use their public tiles. GPX tracks and elevations are stored on this device.
